description:
The distill gate's first divergence after fz-sc8.117: interp, run and build all stop in under 3 s with internal/unresolved-wait (seven waits, all downstream of one).

Cause (verified with instrumentation, patch /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/handoff/probeA.patch): the nested pump drive_product_fact_waits_with_sessions (src/compiler2/product_drive.rs:833-) serves queued product requests only at the top of its loop, and only when world.work_graph.pending_jobs() == 0 (product_drive.rs:858-868). In the failing run a job completes, apply_completion observes Reach(Static(f)) (drive.rs:78-80) and ProductSessions::observe enqueues it (pull.rs:1687). At loop top the agenda still holds one gated job, so the serve is skipped. next_ready_job -> pop_runnable (drive.rs:964-979) parks that job via park_on_gates and returns None with the agenda now empty. The None branch (product_drive.rs:~880-888) settles quiescence (nothing moves), demands the fact producer and pops again; it never re-reads the request queue, so it returns E::no_ready_producer and report_unresolved_waits (world.rs:~3772) fires. f is String.grapheme_bytes_step/3 (the stuck DeriveRecursive waits on its reach); in the full distiller also Enumerable.MapSet.reduce/3. Not caused by .117: base c768670cd fails the same way on the 27-line repro; on min2.fz the base never reaches it (the .117 runaway hides it).

The outer drive_until (drive.rs:1285-1295) already serves requests at its drain point, after next_ready_job returns None. The nested pump answers the same question ("the agenda is drained: what work is left?") a second way, gated on a count taken before the pop that can empty the agenda. Fix shape: one drain step, served where next_ready_job comes back empty, shared by both loops; the loop-top pending_jobs() == 0 guard goes away. A temporary call to drive_product_requests in the None branch removed the stall (reach settled, the repro compiled).

Repros: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/handoff/v6.fz (27 lines, run 'fz2 interp v6.fz x'; elixir: ** (KeyError) key :inclusive not found in: %{}; fixed probe gives the same), min.fz, min2.fz. Only String.slice triggers it among the String functions tried (upcase, graphemes, length, identity, a user-written mutual pair all compile); the surrounding program's size matters.

After the fix min2.fz reaches the next failure: artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan, public closure callsite 2 settled return {:cont | :halt | :suspend, any} disagrees with its semantic result type any. That is the gate's next divergence, not this ticket.

Acceptance: fixture from v6.fz with an elixir oracle on all three paths; a test that observes the request being served at the drain (telemetry); minimal predicted job trace; distill gate re-run.

## Design (page ../fz-sc8.129.html)
One ExecutionContext::drain(also_settled) -> Served | Moved | Silent, used by both drive_until and the product fact-wait pump: serve queued product requests first, then arbitrate quiescence and publish. The pump pops with pop_runnable and only on Silent demands its fact's producer. Removed: the loop-top pending_jobs() == 0 request guard, World::next_ready_job (stale doc; one test caller moves to pop_runnable), apply_quiescence's duplicate publish loop, the outer drive's inline drain block.
title: A product request queued while a gated job parks is served at the drain
